summary.text: Son of Bias (`bias-trojan`) whom Achilles thrust from his chariot to the ground with his sword in close fight — distinct from the primordial founder (`dardanus`) and from the Dardanian eponym king among the Trojans.

story.text: Then setting upon Laogonus and Dardanus, sons twain of Bias, Achilles thrust them both from their chariot to the ground, smiting the one with a cast of his spear and the other with his sword in close fight.
